text:
Marta: FYI we started getting sporadic 413s from /v1/embeddings when customers send mixed-dimension batches. Looks like splitter is routing whole batch to the 384 pool and it rejects the 512 vectors.

Liam: yep saw a customer report. SDK is batching different-length vectors together by default. Current behavior is pretty strict — hard-fail the whole request.

Marta: proposal: add a lightweight preflight check or header so we can route per-item without failing the whole batch. Something like POST /v1/embeddings/preflight that returns dims and suggested route.

Kevin: I'm +1 for server-side detection too (fallback when preflight missing). We should emit telemetry: embed.shape.mismatch counter + histogram of vector lengths per request. That will help console and alerts.

Liam: agree. UX question: should console show a per-route "mismatch rate" and top offending customer payload samples (scrubbed)? DevEx can use that to triage.

Devex-bot: console folks: add a panel "Embeddings: shape guardrails" with metrics: mismatch_rate, preflight_success_rate, avg_batch_variance. Also include a toggle to surface sanitized sample payloads.

Marta: alternative is a header SDKs can set: `X-Embed-Shape: dims=512;count=4` so splitter can fast-path without preflight. But SDK adoption will be slow.

Kevin: we should design both: header for fast-path + preflight as explicit API for conservative clients + server-side best-effort detection. Telemetry should tag which path was used (header|preflight|auto-detect).

Liam: rollout: feature-flag `embed.shape-guardrails` that enables soft-fail + per-item routing. Soft-fail means we split the request and return partial results for compatible items + 207-like metadata for incompatible items. If feature off, preserve current hard-fail behavior.

Marta: sample problematic payload (from repro):
```json
[{"id":"a","embedding":[0.12,0.03,... /*512 floats*/]},
 {"id":"b","embedding":[0.5,0.6,... /*384 floats*/]}]
```
Response we saw: 413 Payload too large (routed to 384 pool).

Kevin: for telemetry fields, propose: `event=embed_mismatch`, `route=embeds.v1`, `customer_id=acct_XXX`, `sample_dims=[512,384]`, `action=split|reject|fallback`, `flag=embed.shape-guardrails`.

Devex-bot: console should allow filtering by `flag` and by `action`. For rollouts we need to show %traffic with flag on + mismatch rate delta.

Liam: ops concern: splitting on the proxy increases RPC count and maybe latency. We'll need a perf budget: allow splitting only when expected latency delta < 50ms or when batch size > N.

Marta: add a preflight TTL so clients don't call it every request; preflight can be cached per-key for 15s. SDKs should reuse.

Kevin: add metrics: preflight_cache_hits, preflight_latency_p50/p95, split_rpc_overhead_estimate.

Deploy-bot: canary for `embed.shape-guardrails` started on 10% traffic for eng-platform-canary pool. Monitor embed_mismatch and 5xx.

Liam: if canary looks good after 1h, we can ramp to 50% and enable sample-logging for top 5 customers to validate behavior.

Marta: ok I'll draft the spec (preflight API + header semantics + telemetry contract + console panels + rollout playbook) and drop a PR.

Kevin: add runbook snippet for oncall: when mismatch_rate spikes > 0.5% for 5m, immediate steps: 1) check preflight_cache_hit ratio 2) rollback flag 3) engage SDK leads.

Liam: sounds good. small nit: prefer `X-Embed-Dims` header name (shorter).

Marta: noted. PR will include both `X-Embed-Dims` and preflight shape API.

Devex-bot: tagging devex for SDK changes.

Marta: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Kevin: :thumbsup:

Liam: moving to implement splitter changes tomorrow.
